markets_note: The snapshot shows the S&P 500 at 7757.17, up 0.5%, the Dow at 52856.09, up 2.39%, and the Nasdaq nearly flat at 26702.86, up 0.04%. The VIX sat at 16.68 and the 10 year yield at 5.15%, while stories point to Meta and IBM earnings as the main focus.

items.title: Missouri Supreme Court disbars Columbia attorney over missed court appearances
items.summary: Missouri Lawyers Weekly reports that the Missouri Supreme Court disbarred a Columbia attorney over missed court appearances. Only the headline was available, so no further details are known. The article is behind a paywall.

items.title: TN High Court Says ‘No’ to PE Ownership of Law Firms But Other Options Open
items.summary: The Tennessee Supreme Court rejected a rule change that would have let private equity companies own law firms. Insurance groups had warned that this kind of ownership could lead to more litigation. This is out of state, so it is persuasive only and does not bind Missouri courts.

items.title: The Cost of Losing Your Cool: Tally the Losses of a Supermarket Cyberattack
items.summary: This piece looks at the insurance and financial effects of a reported cyberattack that interfered with refrigeration at supermarkets in France. Only the opening of the article was available, so the specific losses are not known. It is a foreign event and a general look at cyber loss exposure.

items.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq Gain, Powered By Meta, Tesla Stock — SPCX, META, TSLA, SKYD, IBM In Focus
items.summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq gained, powered by Meta and Tesla, with IBM also in focus. Meta reported earnings that beat expectations while narrowing its capital spending plans.

items.title: IBM Stock Heads For Best Week Since June: CEO Says ‘Q2 Softness Was Timing Rather Than Demand’ After Q3 Beat, Sees Infrastructure Momentum
items.summary: IBM stock is headed for its best week since June after a third quarter earnings beat. The CEO said the second quarter softness was timing rather than weak demand, and he pointed to software growth and rising infrastructure demand.

items.title: Why Meta didn't offer 2027 revenue guidance: Q3 earnings takeaways
items.summary: Meta posted third quarter revenue of $64.6 billion, above the $63.3 billion Wall Street expected. The headline notes the company did not offer 2027 revenue guidance, and only the opening of the piece was available.

items.title: St. Louis police could get new reality TV show, promise it won’t be ‘Cops’
items.summary: St. Louis Public Radio reports that St. Louis police could get a new reality TV show, and the headline says it is promised not to be like the show Cops. Only the headline was available, so no other details are known.

items.title: St. Louis County Executive Sam Page wants regulation on data center sound
items.summary: KSDK reports that St. Louis County Executive Sam Page wants regulation of data center sound. Only the headline was available, so the details of any proposal are not known.

items.title: St. Louis' train quiet zones get 100% of needed upgrades, officials say
items.summary: KSDK reports that officials say St. Louis train quiet zones have received 100% of the needed upgrades. Only the headline was available, so no further details are known.

items.title: An Elite Runner Was Supposed to Run the Detroit Marathon. She Died the Night Before the Race.
items.summary: Runner's World reports that Grace Nolan, 25, an elite runner who was set to run the Detroit Marathon, died the night before the race. She had finished fourth in her marathon debut while in her first semester of medical school.

items.title: I Didn’t Run for a Month Before Boston—and Still Crossed the Marathon Finish Line. How Cross-Training Kept Me on Track for Race Day.
items.summary: A runner tells how cross-training kept her on track for the Boston Marathon after a month without running. The article's advice is that, with a doctor's clearance, you can safely cross-train your way to your next starting line.

items.title: Run/Walkers Can Do Speedwork Too. Here’s How Adding Intervals to Training Cut 10 Minutes Off My Half Marathon Time
items.summary: A run and walk runner explains how adding intervals to training cut 10 minutes off a half marathon time. The piece is a guide to making speedwork feel less intimidating and more effective.
